title: Independent reading: Ephesians 2:11–22
subtitle: Trace remembrance, contrast, reconciliation, and new identity.
overview: Ephesians 2:11–22 moves through a then/now contrast and uses repeated prepositional phrases to describe reconciliation and communal identity.
Mark the imperative-like remembrance opening, the δέ transition, and the purpose/result clauses before resolving theological vocabulary.

items.grc: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ἐγενήθητε ἐγγύς.
items.en: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have become near.

items.grc: αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν.
items.en: For he himself is our peace.
